findings.title: tool-* windows inherit shell:allow-open
evidence: src-tauri/capabilities/default.json windows: [main, tool-*] permissions include shell:allow-open
src-tauri/src/windows/mod.rs creates labels tool-{id} with same app webview
findings.detail: Secondary tool windows share the default capability that allows the shell open plugin. They load the protected React app (not arbitrary HTML), so this is not generated-code shell exec, but tool windows can invoke the same shell.open path as main.
findings.suggestedChange: Split capabilities: keep shell:allow-open on main only; grant tool-* core window permissions without shell:allow-open unless a dedicated open bridge is required.
findings.resolution: Split capabilities: tool-window.json has no shell; open_external_url is the bridge.

findings.title: Frontend openExternalUrl lacks private-host SSRF/open guards
evidence: src/lib/open-url.ts only requires http:// or https:// prefix before plugin-shell open
src-tauri/src/search/safety.rs validate_public_http_url also DNS-resolves and fail-closes
findings.detail: Search result cards call openExternalUrl with result URLs. A crafted http(s) link to 127.0.0.1, localhost, or link-local addresses is not blocked on the frontend path, unlike registered-action and crawl/fetch validators.
findings.suggestedChange: Reuse or port validate_external_url rules into open-url.ts (scheme, no credentials, block private/localhost hosts) before calling shell open.
findings.resolution: openExternalUrl invokes open_external_url which runs validate_public_http_url before shell open.

findings.title: external_link.open host checks do not DNS-resolve
evidence: handlers.rs is_private_host checks literal IPs and localhost suffixes only
search/safety.rs resolve_public_host performs DNS and rejects private resolutions
findings.detail: A hostname that resolves to a private IP could pass external_link.open validation. Impact is reduced because the handler returns a validated URL and does not fetch, and ToolRenderer does not currently auto-open the result via shell.
findings.suggestedChange: Optionally align validate_external_url with validate_public_http_url DNS fail-closed behavior when opening is wired.
findings.resolution: validate_external_url now delegates to validate_public_http_url (DNS fail-closed).

findings.title: CSP img-src allows arbitrary https:
findings.detail: Remote images can load from any https origin (likely for search/media previews). Increases tracking surface relative to an allowlist. script-src remains 'self'; connect-src is limited to self/ipc.
findings.suggestedChange: If product allows, narrow img-src to asset:/data: plus known CDNs, or proxy images through validated asset protocol.

findings.title: CSP style-src includes unsafe-inline
findings.detail: Common for React inline styles; raises XSS impact if HTML injection ever occurs. script-src does not include unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval.
findings.suggestedChange: Long-term migrate to nonces/hashes if inline styles can be eliminated.

findings.title: Credential storage path verified (positive control)
evidence: Secrets never enter SQLite per module docs; resolve.rs split fixes mutex stall (R3)
findings.detail: BYOK keys use OS keyring. Hosted session uses separate keyring path. No plaintext SQLite secret store found in credentials module.

findings.title: High-risk kernel commands registered without frontend wrappers
evidence: reports/tauri-command-inventory.json uninvokedRegistered includes kernel_mark_last_known_good, kernel_export_package_bytes, kernel_set_policy_override, kernel_clear_policy_override
findings.detail: These remain callable via raw invoke from any webview that shares default capabilities. Absence of an api wrapper reduces accidental UI use but does not remove the IPC surface.
findings.suggestedChange: Either add intentional UI + tests, or gate with stronger capability/ACL if Tauri versioning allows per-command permissions.

findings.title: Registered actions cannot reach unrestricted filesystem/shell.exec
evidence: gateway tests exercise shell.exec as blocked path in gateway.rs
findings.detail: Positive control from cleansing phase: bundled actions are permission-bounded; unrestricted shell/fs categories are rejected by policy.

note: P1 findings SEC-CAP-001 and SEC-URL-001 were fixed in the cleansing implementation pass after the initial report-only review.
